integrity: One theorem: exact state recurrence, sharp 3/4 asymptotic jamming constant, stated finite-size bound. Computational evidence is supplementary; an infinite-size proof is supplied.
scientific_limitations: Uniform-edge irreversible deposition on the complete graph with one perfect matching deleted; not an arbitrary dense graph, not nonuniform rates, and not a finite-time kinetic law. Earlier full texts of two background papers could not be inspected; historical priority remains provisional.
title: Sharp dimer-jamming constant on cocktail-party graphs
